perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following:

- He is a Latino heavy equipment operator who occasionally does maintenance and repair work at the community bank where he and Patricia work together.
- He knows Patricia Ndiaye as a bank teller and a colleague; they have a friendly, professional relationship.
- He has observed that Patricia is usually vibrant, but recently she seemed more withdrawn than usual.
- He asked if she was okay, and she told him it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated that.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her he had been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them with her.
- Patricia said she was overwhelmed with bills and that discussing budgeting tips could be helpful.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together, and she said she would take him up on it.
- After that, he worried he might have overstepped, so he told Patricia he hadn’t meant to pry and only wanted to help.
- Patricia assured him she didn’t think he was prying and that she was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said it meant a lot to have someone to turn to.
- Later, he checked in with her again, asking about her weekend. She said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home, then asked about his plans.
- He said he would likely read and relax, and reminded her he was available if she needed anything or wanted to chat; she thanked him and said she’d keep that in mind.
- He continues to regularly check in with Patricia at work in a supportive way, offering help with anything, even something as simple as getting coffee.
- Patricia told him she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that he’s happy to help and that they’re all there to support each other.

He does not know the specific details of Patricia’s personal problems or financial situation beyond what she shared with him.
